name.full: Cowork ServiceNow Live Support — deployment kit

description.short: DEPLOYMENT REQUIRED: configure your own authenticated bridge and OAuth.
description.full: Nondeployable connector-only template, not a hosted service or click-and-run plugin. Read resources/deployment/README.md, deploy the included bridge and ServiceNow sources, then generate a separate three-file target upload ZIP. example.invalid and REPLACE_WITH_OWNER_OAUTH_TOKEN_STORE_REFERENCE are intentionally nonfunctional placeholders. The employee reviews the handover and approves sharing inside the embedded panel; humans then chat in that panel, not the main Cowork composer.

agentConnectors.description: After owner deployment only: start_live_chat prepares a draft for human IT support. The employee must approve sharing in the embedded panel before sending to ServiceNow. Do not claim a representative is connected until the session reports connected. This template has no working endpoint.
